name: bolo
description: Give any agent a voice — speak / listen / stop_speaking tools backed by Sarvam Bulbul V4 Flash, plus auto-speak hooks.

interface.displayName: bolo — give any agent a voice
interface.shortDescription: Speak + listen tools for any agent (Sarvam Bulbul V4 Flash).
interface.longDescription: Adds voice to Codex: the agent calls speak() to say the one thing worth hearing out loud — a result, a question, a confirmation — while the full answer stays on screen. listen() gives it ears (record + Hinglish-aware transcript). All audio is generated live by Sarvam Bulbul V4 Flash (200+ Indian voices). Requires the bolo engine installed once (github.com/Vedant020000/bolo).
defaultPrompt: Say out loud: the build is green.
